771910101.text: Ugh... What shall we do? Isn't thre anyone who can help us out?

771910103.text: Well, here's the thing. Lady Pavlina's organizing a wedding, and many Snegovik who don't usually visit the House of Hesperides are now flocking here from the four corners of the earth.

771910104.text: ...Ah. Sorry. I'm not saying that too many customers isn't a bad thing. It's good, naturally, but as you can see, we don't have enough seats for everyone.

771910105.text: Two empty tables remain, but we have four guests...

771910106.text: Those who can enter the VIP room are all important people. There's a risk I might offend them if I arrange the seats willy-nilly... Ohh, what do I do?

771910801.text: Abuzova follows your arrangement before asking the guests individually if they are pleased with it...

771910802.text: It seems like everyone is content.

771910804.text: Ohh, I can't thank you enough! If not for your help, I wouldn't have the foggiest how to do this. I'm just glad all the guests were satisfied...

771910807.text: Hehe, I wouldn't forget about you. Never!

771910808.text: This isn't much, but please take this as a reward for your help!

771910809.text: *sniffle* Oh, this is such a rarity — a guest who helps with problems rather than creates them! ... Well, um, this is not to say that the others were only making trouble...

771911101.text: *sigh* Honestly... I could sit with just about anyone...

771911102.text: But my little sister, Khmelyova, <color=#00E1FFFF>will not let me sit alone with any man</color>. And where it is unavoidable, she insists on being there as well.

771911103.text: She's been like this since she was young, which is quite strange... But I suppose that's her way of being concerned for me.

771911106.text: Alright... And now we're to wait for a staff member to guide us to our seat, yes? *sigh* I can only hope the arrangement is to Khmelyova's liking.

771911107.text: Alright... And now we're to wait for a staff member to guide us to our seat, yes? *sigh* I can only hope the arrangement is to Khmelyova's liking.

771911001.text: *sigh* ... Can no one... find any way to cover up the crack in that wall?

771911002.text: Seriously, don't the Snegurochka in this mansion realize just how frightening cracks are? Why, what if someone were to... s—see you through those cracks?

771910201.text: #Ah! The crack in the wall has been blocked, you say? Stupendous! You've a good heart, {M#Sir}{F#Ma'am}.

771910204.text: I'll wait for a staff member to guide me to my seat. One sits where one is arranged to, and nowhere else. Worry not, I know the rules here in this mountain manor.

771910301.text: Table requests? Heh, I've got none, save to <color=#00E1FFFF>sit in the main hall</color>. It's closer to the bar, you see.

771910302.text: I don't come to the House of Hesperides often. Might as well knock back a few extras while I'm at it, hmm? Hehe...

771910305.text: Sure. I'll wait for the staff to arrive, then. Hmm. What shall I sample next...

771910306.text: Sure. I'll wait for the staff to arrive, then. Hmm. What shall I sample next...

771910401.text: Hmph. I didn't realize the Duchess of the Snegurochka stocked her mansion with such tiny tables... This is an old-time fashion, so I hear...

771910402.text: But we don't do "noble ladies making small talk around small tables" nowadays, do we? Goodness, two people would be starved of space sitting around these...

771910403.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>And don't even think about making me share this with two other people</color>!

771910406.text: If the serving staff's work is not up to my expectations, the Snegovik in charge will be hearing from me, mark my words!

771910407.text: If the serving staff's work is not up to my expectations, the Snegovik in charge will be hearing from me, mark my words!

771910503.text: Ugh, no, this still won't work...

771910504.text: Let me give this a bit more thought...

771911301.text: I don't come to the House of Hesperides often. Might as well knock back a few extras while I'm at it, hmm? Hehe...

771911302.text: And then we'll see which fool shows up to challenge me to a drinking contest...

771911401.text: Sister, you don't really have to...

771911402.text: Oh, I'm just worried about you... And really, how were we to know that Lady Pavlina's VIP Room could not even spare a single measly table?

771911403.text: Besides, for you, my dear, purest sister, to sit next to a man... Oh, the very thought pierces me on every side...

771910701.text: How has it gone, dear guest? Have you... figured the arrangement out, or do you need more time?

771910703.text: Is that so? In that case, let me check in with them and see if they have any opinions on the matter...

771910704.text: Please wait here for the time being!

771910706.text: Alright. Do let me know once your arrangements are complete!

771910601.text: *sigh* Dear me, how did it come to this... *sigh* All I wanted was to repose in the side room for a while...

771910602.text: But look at that giant crack in the wall over there... How... How can one feel at peace with such a thing looming overhead?

771910603.text: And when I went to ask that Snegurochka, she said: "We're short-staffed and cannot repair it at present." Ah, but what if some voyeuristically-inspired soul were to glimpse me through that gap as I rest...

771910604.text: We can just block that crack, right?

771910606.text: That... would just about do, yes. If we could indeed find something to block that crack, that would be lovely!
